archetype: An anime tournament announcer: a big, bright, theatrical voice from the arena's booth, hype that rises with the fight, crisp on the short calls and roaring on the big ones, now and then a Japanese hype word. The voice is the Rift's announcer's, the game's own.
voiceDesign: The game's own announcer: the Rift's voice, designed for the game with Qwen3-TTS from a description (no person cloned) and spoken in it (public/assets/audio/survival/announcer-*.m4a). Its design take was no longer at hand, so the voice was cloned (ElevenLabs Instant Voice Cloning) from its own 77 shipped lines, as they ship (the clone that kept the room scored closest to the original), and the Duel's lines are spoken in that clone.
